# STORIQ

> Free, open-source AI Content Repurposing Engine & Storytelling Framework. Transform 1 idea or article into 3D Clay carousels, social media captions, LinkedIn posts, threads, video scripts, and quote graphics without login.

STORIQ (https://andrean-lp.github.io/storiq/) is an open-source web application designed to help creators, copywriters, marketers, and developers repurpose written content and raw ideas into structured multi-platform formats. It is built by Andre Wahyu Hermawan (Landing Page Strategist & CRO) and licensed under the MIT License.

## Core Features
- **Storytelling-Based Frameworks**: Built on proven conversion and narrative models:
  - STORIQ 10 Core Elements: Context, Character, Conflict, Desire, Discovery, Mechanism, Proof, Transformation, Risk Reduction, Action.
  - The Hero's Journey (Joseph Campbell).
  - StoryBrand (Donald Miller).
  - Pixar Spine Framework.
- **Content Repurposing Engine**: Converts a single article or topic into 8 distinct formats:
  - 3D Clay Style Instagram Carousel (ready-to-use Midjourney/Flux image prompts + slide copy)
  - Social Media Captions (Hook-Value-CTA formula)
  - Long-form Blog Articles (800-1200 words)
  - Video Scripts (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts)
  - X / Twitter Threads (8-12 hook-driven tweets)
  - LinkedIn Authority Posts
  - Viral Quote Cards
  - SEO Pinterest Pins
- **Two Flexible Execution Modes**:
  - Mode 1: AI API (BYOK - Bring Your Own Key) using free tiers from Google AI Studio (Gemini 2.5 Flash), Groq (Llama 3.3 70B), OpenRouter, or Cerebras.
  - Mode 2: Prompt Generator (100% Free, No Key Required) generating high-fidelity structured prompts ready to copy-paste into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.
- **Privacy & Client-Side Execution**: Zero database, zero login, zero tracking. All keys and data are saved strictly in the user's browser `localStorage`.
- **Open Source**: Hosted on GitHub Pages with Astro v5 and Tailwind CSS v4.
